issue.title: Canonical SASE directories for project and home content
issue.description: Project-local configuration, xprompts, and memory, plus home-managed xprompts and memory, live under one canonical sase/ tree without breaking unmigrated projects, and every enabled project, integration, document, and infographic reflects the new layout.

issue.title: Canonical layout contract and compatibility policy
Project config and xprompt runtime migration
Rust catalog and editor integration alignment
Enabled projects and chezmoi home migration
GPT Image infographic regeneration and review

fields.notes: Implemented the Rust-owned canonical project/home/chezmoi layout contract, exclusive config/memory collision policy, canonical-first xprompt/workflow/steps source order, PyO3 and typed Python adapters, root/symlink/deleted-CWD discovery, display shortening, and chezmoi remapping. Verified with just rust-check and just check.

COMMIT: f4365f309

Implemented the memory and agent-document runtime migration to canonical sase/memory paths with legacy read compatibility, collision handling, safe init migration, canonical AMD references, proposal/read/inventory updates, dirty-path and opt-in integration, and migration coverage. Verification: just fmt passed; all just check format/lint/mypy/pyscripts/symvision/toobig stages passed; SASE plan-links validation passed; committed-plan validation passed; just test passed (17678 passed, 7 skipped). The remaining init --check drift is the expected physical 42-file project/home migration assigned to dependent migration beads, not this runtime bead.

Implemented canonical project config and xprompt/workflow runtime migration with legacy read fallback, collision diagnostics, canonical-only write paths, cross-project catalogs, ACE/CLI save and browser integration, and regression coverage. Verification: just check passed (format, lint, validation, and full tests).

Implemented Phase 4 alignment across sase-core and sase-nvim. Rust catalog now consumes the shared canonical layout for project/workspace xprompts and project config, keeps ordered legacy read fallbacks, reports canonical/legacy config collisions, includes canonical cross-project file prompts, removes obsolete memory-backed xprompt discovery for Python parity, and emits canonical editor/gateway metadata paths. Neovim now applies schemas to sase/sase.yml and sase/xprompts/**/*.{yml,yaml}, retains documented legacy globs, and covers canonical Markdown attachment, alternate editing, definition, snippet, and placeholder fixtures. Audited sase-github (valid unchanged ~/.config/sase/sase.yml and package xprompt references) and sase-telegram (API/command references only); no edits needed. Validation: cargo test --workspace; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --all -- --check; all sase-nvim Lua tests plus definition/snippet/placeholder/VCS LSP smoke tests.

Validation: just check passed with a disposable initialized home; just docs-check passed; project-local memory init is clean, with only sase-6d.6 home/chezmoi drift remaining.

Migrated actstat and bob-cli project config/memory to sase/, regenerated managed instructions (including canonical bob-cli cli_rules.md references), migrated the chezmoi project plus home xprompts/memory, applied the canonical home paths, and confirmed 75 generated provider skills were current. Fixed nested audited external repos inheriting the host checkout marker and added regression coverage. Validation: actstat just check, bob-cli just all, chezmoi just check, focused SASE tests, and full SASE just test pass (17,699 passed). just check reaches validation but reports the expected still-active sase-6d.5 project migration and primary chezmoi-source drift; no files owned by sase-6d.5 were changed.
